_note: The music bed. The film runs at 120 BPM, so the track is slowed or sped to match, and placed so its first kick lands on `kickAt` (seconds into the film: the moment the opening line ends and the app appears). To use another track, replace the file and set its tempo and the time of its first kick; tools/beat.mjs measures both.
